title: /ops/wo keeps every view in the page address: Live Queue filters and the opened WO, Places tab, search, opened place and the Research caps dialog, and Settings as view=settings; a pasted link or F5 reopens the same screen and Back/Forward walks between views
steps: S1: From packages/web/tracy-harness run the test file named in run.cmd.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: A bare /ops/wo is the Live Queue with every default and writes nothing back.
A full queue address and a full Places address round-trip; stage is written as its digit.
Each view reads and writes only its own section; Settings writes only view=settings.
An invalid value drops only its own field; blank or over-long text is dropped; parameters /ops/wo does not own are kept.

tests: a bare /ops/wo is the Live Queue
each view reads and writes only its own section
an invalid value drops only its own field
blank or over-long text is dropped
parameters this module does not own are kept
